Name: Stardew Valley Mod Manager (SVMM)
Author: dnSmane
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew Valley Mod Manager (SVMM)[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Stardew Valley Mod Manager (SVMM)[/b] is a lightweight, portable desktop mod manager for [b]Stardew Valley[/b].

Each modpack/profile lives in its own isolated folder (`SVMM_Data/modpacks/<ProfileName>/`). When you switch profiles or launch the game, SVMM uses OS-level directory junctions (`mklink /J` on Windows, symlinks on macOS/Linux) so your mods swap [b]instantly with zero file copying[/b].

You can also launch [b]Vanilla[/b] cleanly at any time—SVMM unlinks the active `Mods` junction without touching your mod files, and safely backs up any pre-existing unmanaged `Mods` folder to `Mods_Backup`.

[line]

[size=4][b]Main Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Per-Modpack Folder Isolation:[/b] Keep different mod setups completely separate under `SVMM_Data/modpacks/<ProfileName>/`.[/*]
[*][b]Instant Zero-Copy Profile Switching:[/b] Rebuilds profile links and points `Stardew Valley/Mods` via NTFS directory junctions without duplicating gigabytes of mod files.[/*]
[*][b]Safe Vanilla Launch & Automatic Backup:[/b] Launch `Stardew Valley.exe` unmodded at any time. Any pre-existing unmanaged `Mods` folder is automatically backed up to `Mods_Backup`.[/*]
[*][b]In-App Nexus Mods Browser & Installer:[/b] Browse [i]Popular[/i], [i]Latest Updated[/i], and [i]New Mods[/i], search by keyword, and install directly (supports 1-click install for Nexus Premium, automatic `Downloads` folder watching for free browser downloads, and `nxm://` link handling).[/*]
[*][b]Safe `.zip` Mod Installer:[/b] Install single or multi-mod `.zip` archives straight into your active modpack with built-in zip-slip path traversal protection.[/*]
[*][b]Dependency & Conflict Warnings:[/b] Automatically checks SMAPI `manifest.json` files for missing required `Dependencies` and duplicate `UniqueID`s (`⚠` indicator with hover tooltip) and prompts before launching SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]Tolerant SMAPI Manifest Parser:[/b] Handles UTF-8 BOM, `//` and `/* */` comments, trailing commas, and nested modpack subfolders.[/*]
[*][b]Background Mod Update Checker:[/b] Checks `Nexus:<id>` and `GitHub:owner/repo` `UpdateKeys` in the background with local caching (`SVMM_Data/update_cache.json`) and graceful offline support.[/*]
[*][b]Profile Management & UI Quality-of-Life:[/b] Create, duplicate, import, and export profiles as JSON; switch between Dark / Light / System themes; search/filter mods; and open `SMAPI-latest.txt` directly from the launch bar.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/size]
[b]Option A: Standalone Windows Executable (Recommended)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download the latest `SVModManager-vX.Y.Z-windows-x64.zip` from the [b]Files[/b] tab (or [url=https://github.com/smanedn/stardew_mod_manager/releases/latest]GitHub Releases[/url]).[/*]
[*]Extract `SVModManager.exe` into its own dedicated folder (e.g. `C:\Games\SVMM\`).[/*]
[*]Double-click `SVModManager.exe` to launch. [i](If Windows SmartScreen appears because the binary is unsigned, click [b]More info → Run anyway[/b].)[/i][/*]
[*]Click [b]Browse[/b] in the top bar and select your [b]Stardew Valley[/b] installation folder.[/*]
[*]Click [b]Open Modpack Folder[/b] (or use the built-in `.zip` installer / Nexus Browser) to add mods, then click [b]Refresh (F5)[/b].[/*]
[*]Check the mods you want enabled and click [b]LAUNCH MODDED (SMAPI)[/b] or [b]LAUNCH VANILLA (NO MODS)[/b].[/*]
[/list][i]Note: All data (`SVMM_Data/`) is stored portably right next to `SVModManager.exe`.[/i]

[b]Option B: Running from Source (Python)[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Clone or download the source from [url=https://github.com/smanedn/stardew_mod_manager]GitHub[/url].[/*]
[*]Create a virtual environment and install dependencies: `pip install -r requirements.txt`[/*]
[*]Run `python main.py` (on Windows, double-clicking `main.py` automatically detects and uses `.venv` if present).[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (installed locally)[/*]
[*][b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] installed in your Stardew Valley directory (required for modded launches; not required for Vanilla launches)[/*]
[*][b]OS:[/b] Windows x64 (tested; works without Administrator privileges). macOS and Linux are experimental.[/*]
[*][b]If running from source:[/b] Python 3.10+, `customtkinter`, and `pillow>=10.0` (not needed for the standalone `.exe`).[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] A Nexus Mods API key (configured in `SVMM_Data/config.json` or via the in-app Nexus Browser) for browsing/installing from Nexus Mods and checking `Nexus:<id>` updates; an optional `github_token` in `SVMM_Data/config.json` for higher GitHub API rate limits.[/*]
[/list]
